item.title: github: Gemini 4 Hydrogen in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is optimized for fast, efficient agentic coding, tool use, and multistep workflows, with improved instruction following.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: Bring Agentic Coding On-Device with Foundry Local
item.description:
Microsoft says Foundry Local now supports agentic coding directly on developer hardware. The post announces local on-device use of the Qwen3-8-27B model for this workflow.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: github: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for everyday agentic coding and terminal work, and costs less than GPT-6.1 Sol.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6.1 Sol in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6.1 Sol is now generally available and rolling out in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it can be used for agentic coding and terminal workflows with strong multistep performance.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:

item.title: github: Grok 4.6 is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Grok 4.6 is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot as a new reasoning model from xAI. GitHub says it is intended for agentic coding and complex multi-step workflows.
